source: curated by hand (2026-11-03, mcp-server.md §12.9) from the profile by tools/machine-profiler.py on windows, 2026-11-03 and the evidence listed
summary: Classic Buzz kick drum synth: a sine whose pitch sweeps from Start to End, plus buzz, click and punch layers and an amplitude envelope. For 808- and 909-style kicks.
use_for: Tunable synthesised kick drums, from short thumps to long sub sweeps.
quirks: A note triggers it, and its pitch is the lowest the sweep falls to (Pitch limit): A1 or below for deep kicks. The profile heard A4 at 440 Hz from an A4.
Each track is its own kick with its own settings (8 tracks).
The Trigger/volume and NoteDelay columns are pattern-only (not set with param_set).
evidence: profile (tools/machine-profiler.py, windows 2026-11-03) — A4 at 440 Hz, −14 LUFS for a hit

track Buzz.evidence: no measurable change between its ends with the others at their defaults

track Click.evidence: no measurable change between its ends with the others at their defaults

track_parameters.name: Start
track_parameters.description: Pitch the sweep starts at, 34 Hz – 4.2 kHz exponential.
track_parameters.how: Sets the pitch the sweep starts at, 33 Hz x 128^(v/240): about 34 Hz to 4.2 kHz.
track_parameters.sound: Higher starts give a bigger, more clicky beater sweep; low starts give a soft thump.

track_parameters.name: End
track_parameters.description: Pitch the sweep heads for, 33 – 528 Hz exponential (the note sets the floor).
track_parameters.how: Sets the pitch the sweep heads for, 33 Hz x 16^(v/240): about 33 Hz to 528 Hz; the note sets a floor under it.
track_parameters.sound: Lower values give a deep sub body; higher values a tonal, tuned kick.

track_parameters.name: Buzz
track_parameters.how: Sets the level of the buzz layer, 0 to 100 percent.
track_parameters.sound: More buzz adds a gritty, fizzy body to the kick.

track_parameters.name: Click
track_parameters.how: Sets the level of the click layer, 0 to 100 percent.
track_parameters.sound: More click gives a sharper attack, like a beater hitting a skin.

track_parameters.name: Punch
track_parameters.how: Sets how much the pitch is pushed up at the start of the hit, 0 to 100 percent.
track_parameters.sound: More punch gives a stronger, snappier front to the kick.

track_parameters.name: T DecRate
track_parameters.how: Sets how fast the pitch falls from Start to End, 1 to 240 on a linear scale.
track_parameters.sound: Low values give a long slow sweep; high values a short snap.

track_parameters.name: T DecShape
track_parameters.how: Bends the pitch fall's curve, 1 to 240: the fall follows time to the power of twice this fraction.
track_parameters.sound: Low values drop the pitch early and then hold; high values keep it up and drop late.

track_parameters.name: B DecRate
track_parameters.description: How fast the buzz layer fades.
track_parameters.how: Sets how fast the buzz layer fades, 1 to 240.
track_parameters.sound: Higher values make the buzz vanish quickly; low values let it ring on through the hit.

track_parameters.name: C+P DecRate
track_parameters.description: How fast click and punch fade.
track_parameters.how: Sets how fast the click and punch layers fade, 1 to 240.
track_parameters.sound: Higher values keep the attack very short; low values leave it audible for longer.

track_parameters.name: A DecSlope
track_parameters.how: Sets how steeply the level falls (in a straight line) during the decay time, 1 to 240; the slope grows exponentially with the value.
track_parameters.sound: Low values fall slowly and keep the body long; high values cut the level quickly.

track_parameters.name: A DecTime
track_parameters.description: Time before the release begins, 4 ms – 1 s.
track_parameters.how: Sets how long the decay stage lasts before the release begins, from 4 ms to 1 s.
track_parameters.sound: Short values make a tight kick; long ones a sustained boom.

track_parameters.name: A RelSlope
track_parameters.description: Steepness of the release after the decay time.
track_parameters.how: Sets how steeply the level falls once the decay time has passed, 1 to 240.
track_parameters.sound: Low values leave a long fade-out; high values end the hit abruptly.
